proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: Continual Flame's sole mechanical payload is producing magical light with specific bright-light and dim-light radii. Light conditions are mechanically relevant in 5e (bright → normal, dim → lightly obscured, darkness → heavily obscured / blinded). No 'emit_light' or equivalent atom exists in EffectAtom or in the v4 taxonomy (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §9). This is the first SRD spell whose entire effect is a persistent light emission on an object, so the atom is genuinely new rather than a missing surface instantiation of an existing v4 concept.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

notes: Structural shape fits cleanly: activation family, permanent duration with endsOn=[dispel], object attachment at touch range, direct phase, material component consumed. The only blocker is the absence of an emit_light effect atom. The v4 taxonomy has no lighting-related atom at all, so this is atom_widening rather than surface_widening. Secondary flavor properties (no heat, no fuel, immune to smothering/quenching) are object-behavior notes with no deterministic mechanical resolution; they would remain unencoded even after emit_light is added.
